sql: select count(*) from san_suggestions s where row_to_json(s)::text like '%0900000222%'

select count(*) from san_suggestions where id = (select max(id) from san_suggestions) and msg_ref ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' and answer !~* '(https?://|www\.|[a-z0-9-]+\.(com|vn|net)\b)' and answer !~ '(\+84|0)[0-9][0-9 .-]{7,}'
